title: Global Youth Reimagine Systems Amid Uncertainty
discussion_signal: The post interprets Youth Pulse 2026 through living costs, labour-market change, declining institutional trust, social fragmentation, environmental risk, AI, community, and purpose. It presents youth as values-driven actors balancing optimism about innovation with concern about institutional capacity and economic pressure.
linked_research_question: How do cost pressure, AI, community, and institutional trust shape young people’s cultural and political sense of purpose?
limits: Individual interpretation of a WEF report
